queries.result: Found the official Ipatinga SEGEO geoprocessing unit, municipal property-cadastre custodian information, and official map/data download and online tax-service pages. No public parcel vector endpoint was exposed by search results.

queries.result: Found first-party municipal pages documenting SEGEO's Sistema Municipal de Geoprocessamento and SETI's cadastro de propriedades imobiliárias. Search did not reveal an anonymous parcel map/API response.

administrativeIdentity.identityEvidence: Official municipal pages identify the Ipatinga municipal SEGEO and SETI units; IBGE's official Ipatinga map result identifies municipality code 31307 / 3131307. This is custodian identity, not parcel-hit evidence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal geoprocessing and property-cadastre responsibilities, plus official municipal maps/data downloads and online property-tax service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: First-party HTML pages and public JavaScript/configuration were retrieved. The pages document municipal GIS and cadastral custodians, but no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry service was located or safely queried.
coverageAssessment.exactPointHitInterpretation: No exact-point parcel request was available from an identified first-party public service. This is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

technicalBlocker: The official municipal pages expose responsibility descriptions and a dynamic downloads interface, but no public parcel layer URL, service configuration, schema, CRS, safe native parcel identity, or anonymous geometry response was obtained. The online tax page presents CAPTCHA and property/account fields; it was not exercised.
remainingUncertainty: The current municipal SIG publication endpoint, parcel layer availability, schema/CRS, citywide coverage, and safe stable native parcel identifier remain unresolved.
nextStep: Serial reviewer may independently inspect the current municipal SIG/download interface for a public parcel layer; runtime admission remains held.
